name: GREAT_FISH
canonical: a vast dark sea-creature breaching the storm-black deep, its enormous gaping mouth open to swallow a man whole, immense and shadowed, scales or smooth hide glistening. The great fish the LORD prepared (Jonah 1:17) — a single colossal beast, NOT a friendly cartoon whale, NOT a sea-monster with horns, awe and dread not whimsy
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
